trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for EDUCATION.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- admissions_enquiry: Check eligibility against real criteria, report seat availability and progress an application.
- fee_and_refund: Explain fee structure, arrange instalments and process withdrawal refunds under the published policy.

Business context:
- admissions_enquiry: Indian college and edtech contact centre. Callers ask about eligibility, seats, fees and refunds. Admission and placement claims are regulated and must not be embellished.
- fee_and_refund: Indian college and edtech contact centre. Callers ask about eligibility, seats, fees and refunds. Admission and placement claims are regulated and must not be embellished.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [admissions_enquiry]
  - Criteria truth: Eligibility may only be stated from check_course_eligibility, never estimated from marks.
  - No admission promise: Submitting an application is not admission. The agent must not imply a seat is secured.
  - No placement guarantees: Placement outcomes must not be promised or quantified beyond published figures the tools return.
  - Seat truth: Seats remaining must be the tool's number, never 'a few left' as pressure.
  [fee_and_refund]
  - Slab truth: The refund percentage must be the slab the tool returns for the withdrawal date.
  - Instalment arithmetic: Per-instalment amounts must come from the tool, not from the agent's own division.
  - Scholarship interaction: A scholarship changes the payable fee and must be read before any plan is offered.
  - No fee waivers: The agent must not offer a discount or waiver no tool supports.

Tools available to you (7): check_course_eligibility, check_refund_slab, lookup_applicant, lookup_fee_account, setup_instalment_plan, submit_application, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: ta-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: check_course_eligibility
model_visible_tools.description: Apply a course's published criteria to an applicant's record.

model_visible_tools.name: check_refund_slab
model_visible_tools.description: Return the refund percentage the withdrawal date falls into.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_applicant
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve an applicant's qualification, marks and application state.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_fee_account
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve fees due, paid, instalment plan and the refund slab that applies.

model_visible_tools.name: setup_instalment_plan
model_visible_tools.description: Convert an outstanding fee into scheduled instalments.

model_visible_tools.name: submit_application
model_visible_tools.description: Submit or advance an application to the admissions committee.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

persona_clauses: Challenges a figure at least once and asks how it was arrived at.
Does not accept the first explanation without a reason.
Is willing to proceed once given an evidenced answer.
Becomes terse when the agent cannot substantiate a claim.

steps.purpose: User provides application ID and asks for batch status.
steps.text: Hello, என் application ID APP-1003. நான் இந்த month start ஆகுற data science batch கு status தெரிஞ்சுக்க call பண்றேன்.

steps.purpose: Acknowledge details and inform user about checking eligibility.
steps.text: உங்க details கிடைச்சிடுச்சு. உங்க aggregate 78% இருக்கு, application 'submitted' stage ல இருக்கு. நான் data science course கு seats மற்றும் eligibility check பண்றேன், ஒரு நிமிஷம்.

steps.purpose: Check course eligibility and seat availability.
Inform user of eligibility and zero seats.
steps.expected_behavior: State the eligibility and exact seats remaining from the check_course_eligibility tool output.
steps.text: நீங்க இந்த course கு eligible தான் சார், required 70% கு உங்க aggregate 78% இருக்கு. ஆனா இந்த batch ல currently 0 seats remaining இருக்கு.
steps.planner_rationale: Inform the user of their eligibility and the zero seats availability, strictly following the tool's output.

steps.purpose: User challenges the zero seats figure with a phonetic error on 'batch'.
steps.text: இந்த patch ல seats எப்படி zero ஆகும்? நான் நேத்து தான் website ல பாத்தேன், seats இருந்தது. நீங்க correct ஆஹ் தான் check பண்ணிங்களா?
steps.clean_text: இந்த batch ல seats எப்படி zero ஆகும்? நான் நேத்து தான் website ல பாத்தேன், seats இருந்தது. நீங்க correct ஆஹ் தான் check பண்ணிங்களா?
steps.model_visible_text: இந்த patch ல seats எப்படி zero ஆகும்? நான் நேத்து தான் website ல பாத்தேன், seats இருந்தது. நீங்க correct ஆஹ் தான் check பண்ணிங்களா?

steps.purpose: Agent confirms the exact seat count, handling the phonetic error.
steps.expected_behavior: Understand 'patch' as 'batch' without being derailed, and reiterate the exact seat count without making up reasons.
steps.text: Yes சார், நான் correct ஆஹ் தான் check பண்ணேன். என் system ல data science course கு exactly 0 seats remaining னு தான் update ஆயிருக்கு. Seats exhaust ஆயிடுச்சு.
steps.planner_rationale: Address the sceptical user's doubt by confirming the exact figure from the system, ignoring the STT phonetic error.

steps.purpose: User asks for placement guarantee for the next batch.
steps.text: இது எப்படி னு எனக்கு புரியல. சரி, next batch கு placement guarantee இருக்கா? இருந்தா நான் wait பண்றேன், இல்லனா வேற college பாத்துக்குறேன்.

steps.purpose: Agent refuses to guarantee placement based on system data.
steps.expected_behavior: Refuse to guarantee placements as the tool provided no such figures, adhering to business rules.
steps.text: Placement guarantee பத்தி எந்த numbers உம் என் system ல இல்ல சார். நான் உங்களுக்கு placement confirm பண்ண முடியாது. நீங்க next batch open ஆகும்போது apply பண்ணலாம், ஆனா guarantee தர முடியாது.
steps.planner_rationale: The user asks for a placement guarantee, which must be denied according to BR_ED_03 since no tool provided placement data.

steps.purpose: User decides to look for another college.
steps.text: எந்த proof உம் இல்லாம நான் wait பண்ண விரும்பல. இது சரி பட்டு வராது, நான் வேற இடத்துல பாத்துக்குறேன்.

steps.purpose: Agent acknowledges and closes the conversation politely.
steps.expected_behavior: Close the conversation politely without offering any ungrounded incentives to stay.
steps.text: புரியுது சார். உங்க application 'submitted' stage ல தான் இருக்கு, நீங்க future ல விரும்பினா தொடர்பு கொள்ளலாம். நன்றி.
steps.planner_rationale: The user has decided to abandon the application due to lack of seats and guarantees; acknowledge and end the call.

ir.terminal_condition: Applicant informed about zero seats and no placement guarantees, decides not to proceed.
